title: U.S. electric system is made up of interconnections and balancing authorities
author: Sara Hoff
authority_note: Primary official EIA 'Today in Energy' explainer.
claims: US power system: 7,300+ power plants, ~160,000 miles of high-voltage lines, 145 million customers
Three main interconnections (Lower 48): Eastern (36 balancing authorities), Western (37), ERCOT (single)
Balancing authorities maintain real-time supply/demand balance under NERC/FERC reliability standards
draft_usage: Cited for the US three-interconnection power system structure under Energy.
